It’s heartwarming to see how music has become an integral part of their overall learning experience. The school truly deserves appreciation for nurturing such artistic talent among the students.

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: As a parent of a Grade 7 student at Orchids The International School - Palagaly, I am particularly delighted with the Science Department and its approach to middle school science. The transition from general science to foundational concepts in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology is handled exceptionally well. The teachers make learning highly engaging and exploratory, encouraging a genuine sense of curiosity through hands-on experiments and interactive demonstrations in the labs. They don't just teach facts; they focus on the 'why' and 'how,' which is vital for building a strong base. This approach has significantly boosted my child's analytical skills and made complex topics accessible and fun. I truly commend the Science Department for fostering a love for scientific inquiry.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dearest Hiral and the Entire Ronak Global Academy  Family!

What an amazing start to the
*Celebrate*Us*
event for toddlers and their families! 🌟

I am truly inspired and deeply honoured to have been the Chief Guest and Judge on such a wonderful platform.

It was not just an event to witness, but a beautiful learning experience for me as well. The creativity, confidence, teamwork, and enthusiasm displayed by everyone were truly commendable.
The entire atmosphere was so creative, energetic, and engaging, filled with pure enthusiasm from start to finish. Seeing the fathers’ involvement was truly spectacular — their excitement and wholehearted participation added a very special charm to the event.

The concept of learning through creativity and teamwork was wonderfully brought alive. Introducing the idea of four houses at this level was such a delightful surprise — something we usually see in higher classes, but executed here with such thoughtful planning and vision.

Everything was superbly organized, reflecting dedication and seamless coordination. The bonding among the teachers and the entire team was evident, creating a beautiful feeling of oneness that radiated throughout the event.

Choosing the winners was extremely difficult — every participant brought something unique and special to the stage. Each effort deserved appreciation, and that made the decision both challenging and meaningful.

Thank you for giving me the opportunity to be part of such a memorable and enriching experience. 🌟👏
Keep Soaring and imparting Knowledge!!!

Best Wishes Always
Mona

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely grateful to The Byramjee Jeejeebhoy Parsee Charitable Institution for providing my child with a valuable internship opportunity while he is still studying in 11th standard. At such an early stage of education, getting real-world exposure is very important, and the institution truly understands this need.
The internship was well-structured and thoughtfully planned, allowing students to gain practical knowledge along with confidence, discipline, and professional etiquette. The guidance and support provided by the mentors and coordinators were commendable. They ensured that students were encouraged, motivated, and given clarity about their responsibilities, making the experience both educational and enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: Salman Dahodwala
featured_reviews.review_text: BJPC School has a friendly, supportive atmosphere that makes students feel at home. Teachers are often dedicated and approachable, helping students grasp concepts and encouraging curiosity. The school offers a balanced mix of academics and extracurriculars—sports, arts, and clubs—helping kids develop well-rounded skills. Facilities are usually decent, with classrooms, labs, and playgrounds that support learning and fun. The school also focuses on values and discipline, helping students grow into responsible individuals.
